title: Canonical normalized diagonal DNC and ordinary dualizing chart transports
statement:
Fix the finite coefficient datum $P$ of [def-pur-conventions], with its ordinary etale and small pro-etale derived pullbacks [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], exceptional inverse image [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image], and section invariant $C(g,s)=Ls^*Rg^!A$ [def-pur-section-invariant]. This definition names two canonical chart transports and the affine-projection typing fact used to form the diagonal chart diagram of [def-pur-diagonal-dnc-chart-data].

For a separated finite-type smooth morphism $h:U\to V$ of pure relative dimension $d\in\mathbf N$ [def-weil-proper-morphism] [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], and a finite-type map $a_V:V\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ such that $U\to\operatorname{Spec}k$ is separated, put $W=U\times_VU$, $p_1:W\to U$, and $\Delta:U\to W$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Define $\delta_h:C(p_1,\Delta)\xrightarrow{\sim}C(\pi_N,z_N)$ to be the uniquely coordinate-normalized DNC isomorphism selected from [thm-pur-dnc-invariance]. Thus it is the comparison obtained by reading the same normalized family trivialization at $t=1$ and $t=0$, not a newly chosen isomorphism between its endpoints.

For a separated finite-type smooth map $f:X\to Y$ of pure relative dimension $d$, a finite-type map $a_Y:Y\to\operatorname{Spec}k$, and a Cartesian square with maps $a:X'\to X$, $b:Y'\to Y$, $f':X'\to Y'$, suppose $f'$ is compactifiable [def-asd-compactifiable] and quasi-compact. Define the ordinary dualizing exchange $La^*\omega_f^e\xrightarrow{\sim}\omega_{f'}^e$, where $\omega_f^e=Rf^!A_Y$ is the ordinary realization of [thm-pur-diagonal-dualizing-object], by the canonical tensor-unit-to-coefficient comparisons on both ends of the inverse-compact-support adjunction mate. Its middle arrow is exactly the ordinary dualizing base-change map, invertible by smooth base change; no independently chosen exchange is used.

For every scheme $B$ and $r\in\mathbf N$, retain the typing fact that the ordered affine-tower projection $\mathbf A^r_B\to B$ of [def-amb-affine-trace-tower] is smooth of pure relative dimension $r$. This includes $r=0$ and the empty base. These are definitions and their typing facts, not the diagonal chart-normalization equality.

lean.statement:
def chartOrdinaryBaseChange (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    {X Y X' Y' : Scheme.{u}} (d : ℕ) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d f]
    (aY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType aY] [QuasiCompact aY]
    (b : Y' ⟶ Y) (f' : X' ⟶ Y') (a : X' ⟶ X)
    [HasCompactification f'] [QuasiCompact f'] (sq : IsPullback a f' f b) :
    letI := Dnc.compactifiable P f aY
    (Etale.ordinaryFinitePullback P.Coefficient a).obj
      (P.diagonalOrdinaryDualizing f) ≅ P.diagonalOrdinaryDualizing f'
